messages:
alice.k: Quick triage — ProspectX demo hung; webview showed 'Unexpected end of JSON input' while streaming at ~15:10 UTC.
ben.s: Can we see client console + gateway trace?
dana_support: Got client console: 'SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input'. Gateway shows SSE events where one logical object spanned two data: lines and connection closed before terminator.
felix_ps: Their parser assumes each data: line is complete JSON. That's brittle for multi-line events.
eng_oncall: Proxy sent FIN; likely client/proxy closed mid-event. Not a 5xx from runtime.
dana_support: Sent them a tiny robust parser to accumulate event body until blank line and then JSON.parse; recommended keepalive pings and test on non-proxy network.
ben.s: Short-term: share snippet + ask for HAR. Medium: add SDK helper for WebView parsing and server canary to flush per-event for demo tokens.
alice.k: ProspectX wants a hotfix we can drop in now. Dana, DM the snippet and instructions.
dana_support: Done. Also logged infra ticket to raise haproxy upstream_write_timeout for demo windows.
eng_oncall: Will roll canary flush change to 5% tonight. Notify when live.
alice.k: Thanks, will reschedule demo once canary live. :thumbsup:
